header: Submitting a manuscript to the Quarterly
description: Submissions open twice a year, and everything runs through Compass. Plan an hour for the first upload, most of it for the checklist.

items.title: Prepare the files
items.content: You need an anonymised manuscript as a PDF, the analysis set as a separate archive and a title page with every author's ORCID. Figures need at least 300 dpi.

items.title: Answer the checklist
items.content: The checklist has 11 questions on data availability, consent, funding and conflicts of interest. The answers are published with the paper, so write them for readers.

items.title: Track the decision
items.content: Compass shows the handling editor and the current stage. Two referees read at the same time. Expect a first decision in 21 days, or a note from us if it takes longer.
